$comment: Repo-owned build hints. NOT exported from Figma, and deliberately kept out
of src/figma/*.json so a re-export cannot wipe them.
Figma has no concept of 'this number is a count, not a length'. Every FLOAT
looks the same to the export, so anything the build must treat differently
is recorded here by token path.
Add to this file, never to src/figma/.

unitless.$comment: FLOAT tokens that must NOT get a px suffix in CSS.

$comment: Generic-family fallbacks appended to every fontFamily token in CSS.
Figma cannot express these. A Figma FONT_FAMILY variable holds one real
family that Figma has to be able to render; putting a CSS fallback list
in it would make Figma look for a font literally named
'Host Grotesk, system-ui, sans-serif'. So the stack is a CSS delivery
fact, which is exactly what this file is for.
Keyed by the resolved family name, not by token path, so a Semantics
token inherits the stack from the Primitive it aliases. Style Dictionary
resolves aliases before value transforms run, so font/family/sans and
font/family/host-grotesk both arrive here as 'Host Grotesk'.
Every family the export contains MUST have an entry — build-css.mjs
fails otherwise. Bare families are how the system came to render in a
default serif when the webfonts did not load.
CSS generic families and system keywords are NOT quoted; the generator
quotes only names containing a space.
